children: France conglomerate's H1 2026 revenue grew 8% at constant scope and exchange rates
Adjusted EBITA for H1 2026 fell 15% yr/yr, mainly due to lower Communications segment earnings
Net income for H1 2026 dropped sharply, reflecting lower operating and financial income
Company did not provide specific guidance for future periods
ENERGY PRICES - Bollore Energy revenue rose due to higher prices amid Middle East conflict, despite lower volumes sold
COMMUNICATIONS WEAKNESS - Lower adjusted operating income was mainly due to reduced contributions from Groupe Canal+ and UMG
DIVIDEND PAYMENTS - Net cash position fell sharply following payment of exceptional dividends
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is 1 "strong buy" or "buy", 3 "hold" and 1 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the entertainment production peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Bollore SE is €4.55, about 22.8% above its September 15 closing price of €3.71
The stock recently traded at 32 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 35 three months ago
